text: Sitting in an airport in transit, 4 hours until my next flight, and I have decided this terminal is actually a perfectly acceptable place to exist for the afternoon.
I am writing this from a train to Positano and I keep looking up from my phone because I do not want to miss what is outside the window.
In the Sahara last night watching stars I have never seen from a home city. The silence was so complete it had a texture to it.
What language do I need in Morocco? I have basic French. Is that enough outside the big cities?
Compared taxi apps in Bangkok: Grab, Bolt, and InDrive. Over 20 rides, Grab averaged 180 THB, Bolt 165 THB, InDrive 140 THB. InDrive lets you negotiate the fare, which explains the lower average.
Compared a 10-day Morocco itinerary done independently vs guided tour. Independent: $780 total. Guided tour: $2,100. The tour covered identical sites.
London is an incredible city to live in and a mediocre one to visit. The tourist circuit is worse than a dozen European capitals at half the cost.
Checked correlation between Booking.com and TripAdvisor scores for 25 hotels I have stayed at. The platforms disagreed by more than 0.5 points on 9 of 25. Neither is consistently more accurate.
You are not discovering anything. The concept of travel discovery ended when GPS maps became free. What you are doing is tourism, and that is completely fine.
Is it worth taking the slow boat from Thailand to Laos, or is it 2 days of not much that I should skip?

Checked the 2025 Lonely Planet top 10 against their 2020 list. 6 of 10 cities appeared in both. The 4 new entries were all smaller cities and all had dramatically cheaper accommodation than the repeats.
First day in Seoul and the subway is so well-signed that I made 4 transfers without any anxiety and I am a person who usually has subway anxiety.
Is there a reliable way to get between Hoi An and Hue without booking through a hotel tour desk? Looking for something that does not add a 40% premium.

Measured walking distances between major attractions in Kyoto using Google Maps. Fushimi Inari to Nishiki Market is 8.2km on foot. A city bus covers it in 35 minutes and costs ¥230. Most visitors walk it and spend 2 hours getting lost.
Took 50+ long-distance buses in South America. The ones worth taking are in Argentina and Chile. Everywhere else is an endurance test.
What documents do I need to rent a car in Japan as a foreign visitor? I have heard an international driving permit is required but wanted to confirm.
Booked a cooking class in Bangkok on a whim. Spent 4 hours learning to make Pad Thai from someone who has been doing it for 35 years. Better morning than anything I planned.
Anyone know whether it is possible to cross from Israel to Jordan at the Allenby Bridge without a pre-arranged visa? The information online is contradictory.

Looked at Booking.com prices vs the hotel direct rate for 8 hotels across 3 countries. Direct rates were equal or lower in 5 cases, higher in 2, and unavailable in 1. The book-direct messaging is real but not universal.
How early do you need to queue for the Vatican Museums even with a timed ticket?
Tracked baggage fee costs across 12 European low-cost carriers. Ryanair averages €32 per bag, Wizz Air €28, EasyJet €33. These fees now add 40-60% to the base ticket price for a typical weekend trip.
Any country that makes you think about your personal safety more than twice before arriving is telling you something worth listening to.
What is the best time of year to visit Sri Lanka if I want to see both the south coast beaches and the cultural triangle in the same trip?
After 6 months in South America, Colombia wins. Not close. The others are fine but Colombia is the one you go back to.
Flying into Bangkok for the first time next month. Is 4 days enough to see the main things before heading south, or should I add more time?
Looked at Airbnb vs hostel prices in Barcelona for September. A private room in a central hostel averaged €68/night; comparable Airbnbs ran €95-120. The hostel wins unless you need a kitchen.
First day in Budapest and I found a thermal bath by accident by following steam rising from a building. Fell asleep in a pool like I have been coming here for years.
After 4 months backpacking Europe, I am convinced the Balkans are what the rest of Europe was before it got discovered and priced accordingly.
What is the realistic daily budget for Vietnam if I am staying in mid-range guesthouses and eating locally?

Accommodation costs for 4 weeks in Colombia: Cartagena $38/night average, Medellín $28/night, Bogotá $31/night, coffee region hostels $22/night. Medellín is the best value of any major South American city I have visited.
Just crossed into Morocco from Spain and the world changed completely over a 35-minute ferry. I was not expecting the shift to be that fast.
Over-scheduled itineraries are the enemy of good travel. The best things that happened to me abroad were in gaps I left in the plan.
Paris would be the best city in Europe if Parisians wanted to be there. They clearly do not, and that energy permeates every tourist interaction.
The best travel photos are always the ones you took for yourself and not for Instagram. The posed ones look like stock photos.
The authentic local experience in any major tourist destination is a performance put on for tourists. There is nothing authentic left in central Lisbon.
Cuba is not worth the logistical difficulty unless you are specifically interested in 1950s cars and live music. Everything else is more available elsewhere.
Day 3 in Seville and I have started timing my meals to the local schedule. Dinner at 10pm. I am fully nocturnal and fine with it.
What is the best way to get between Budapest and Prague? Train, bus, or flight?
Has anyone done a DIY trip to Antarctica from Ushuaia? Is that even possible or do you need to go through a tour operator?
Visited Patagonia in March vs November, same itinerary. March: 18°C average, 4 rainy days, 30% fewer people on the W Trek than November. Accommodation 20% cheaper, flights 15% cheaper.
What do people actually wear for hiking in Patagonia in January? I have packed thermal layers and a waterproof shell but I am not sure if that is enough.
Travel bloggers who say a destination is underrated are always wrong. If they have 200,000 followers it is not underrated anymore.
Hotel breakfasts are a tourist trap. The best meal in any city is at a local café that does not have a TripAdvisor sticker in the window.
Arrived in Nairobi for a safari and the drive from the airport had more wildlife than I expected. Two giraffes, one warthog, and something I am still identifying.
Is the Patagonia W Trek doable without a guide, and how far in advance do the huts book up?
Does anyone have experience with the ferry from Split to the islands in shoulder season? How frequent are they in October?

The Shinkansen from Tokyo to Osaka is 2h15 with a reserved seat on the Nozomi. Flying the same route, including transit to Narita, is about 3h45. Train is faster every time and costs about ¥13,000 versus ¥8,000 for the cheapest flight.
What is the situation with entry requirements for Georgia right now for a US passport holder? I have read it is visa-free but want to confirm the length of stay permitted.
Just landed in Tokyo for the first time and I genuinely do not know how to process what I am looking at. The scale of this city is something photos have never captured.
A two-week trip is too short for anywhere genuinely interesting. You are just scratching the surface and going home thinking you have been somewhere.
Is there a free or low-cost way to see the Taj Mahal at sunrise without booking a private tour? I am trying to figure out if you can just show up at opening.
